A skilled Lynel can draw this sword simply in passing and still cut a foe in two.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 36 |durability = 32 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Mighty Lynel Sword}} Mighty Lynel Swords are [[Weapon]]s that are used by [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s. In [[Master Mode]], though, they are wielded by [[White-Maned Lynel]]s. Because most [[Lynel]]s scale up as [[Link]] defeats [[Enemy|Enemies]], Mighty Lynel Swords may become more scarce as the game progresses. However, the Blue-Maned Lynel in the [[First Gatehouse]] of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] does not scale up, making it a permanent source of Mighty Lynel Swords. Skilled Lynels are able to draw this Sword in passing and still damage their foes. They belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a collection of Weapons that are created by Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} As metallic [[Weapon]]s, Mighty Lynel Swords will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. However, they can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], which is useful since they sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]].
